name: Forest-filtered light

original_specification.name: Forest-filtered light
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for products among vegetation.
original_specification.sources: Sun and sky through existing leaves
original_specification.geometry: Real foliage or correctly filtered cutouts
original_specification.contribution_policy: Leaf transmission and openings; no duplicated pattern projector
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Dappled pattern follows foliage rather than temporal noise

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Native GPU realization uses a finite rectangular emitter; a directional/spot angular model is retained as intent, not silently equated to a measured fixture.
